full_name: Kathryn Sikkink | Radcliffe Institute for Advanced Study at Harvard University
title: 2014–2015 Social Sciences Carol K. Pforzheimer Professor Harvard Kennedy School
bio: Kathryn Sikkink is the Ryan Family Professor of Human Rights Policy at the Harvard Kennedy School and the Carol K. Pforzheimer Professor at the Radcliffe Institute for Advanced Study. Sikkink is best known for her work on transnational social movements, especially her book Activists beyond Borders: Advocacy Networks in International Politics (Cornell University Press, 1998), coauthored with Margaret Keck and awarded the Grawemeyer Award for Ideas Improving World Order and the Chadwick F. Alger Prize.
